name: com.spalla.sdk.android.core.player.fullscreen.FullScreenPlayerActivity
description: When the host app requests full-screen playback, the Spalla SDK player opens this screen for a video and accepts live-content and autoplay settings. It keeps playback in sync as the screen resumes, pauses, or closes, and can open cast controls.
disableEffect: The Spalla SDK's full-screen video player cannot open.
